entranceFees.title: Acadia Entrance Fee - Private Vehicle
entranceFees.description: Admits private, non-commercial vehicle (15 passenger capacity or less) and all occupants. Valid for 7 days. If a vehicle pass is purchased, no other pass is necessary.

entranceFees.title: Acadia Entrance Fee - Motorcycle
entranceFees.description: Admits one or two passengers on a private, non-commercial motorcycle. Valid for 7 days.

entranceFees.title: Acadia Entrance Fee - Per Person
entranceFees.description: Admits one individual with no car (bicyclist, hiker, pedestrian). Youth 15 and under are admitted free of charge. Valid for 7 days.

entrancePasses.title: Acadia Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Valid for 12 months from purchase date. This pass provides access to Acadia National Park only. This pass admits the pass holder and passengers in a non-commercial vehicle.

entranceFees.title: Private Vehicle Fee
entranceFees.description: Admits one private, non-commercial vehicle (15 passenger capacity or less) and all its occupants.

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle Fee
entranceFees.description: Admits a private, non-commercial motorcycle and its riders.

entranceFees.title: Per Person
entranceFees.description: Admits one individual with no car. Typically used for bicyclists, hikers, and pedestrians. Youth 15 and under are admitted free.

entranceFees.title: Timed Entry Ticket Fee
entranceFees.description:
From April 1 through October 31, 2023, visitors entering the park in a vehicle between 7 am and 4 pm will need to have already purchased a 
Timed Entry Ticket from Recreation.gov before reaching the park. One ticket is needed per vehicle. This fee is a Recreation.gov service charge, so it is not waived by any of the interagency passes.

entrancePasses.title: Southeast Utah Parks Pass
entrancePasses.description: Valid for one year through the month of purchase. Admits one (1) private, non-commercial vehicle or its pass holder to Arches and Canyonlands national parks, and Natural Bridges and Hovenweep national monuments.

entranceFees.title: Private Vehicle
entranceFees.description: Fee covers the entry of a private vehicle and its occupants for 7 days

entranceFees.title: Individual (Hiking, Bicycling, etc...)
entranceFees.description: Fee covers the entry of an individual that is hiking, bicycling, etc... for 7 days

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle
entranceFees.description: Fee covers the entry of a motorcycle and its occupants for 7 days

entranceFees.title: Commercial Sedan, 1 to 6 passenger capacity
entranceFees.description: Commercial sedan, 1 to 6 passenger capacity.   $25 plus $10 per person - 7 days for Original Manifest

entranceFees.title: Commercial Van, 7 to 15 passenger capacity
entranceFees.description: Commercial van, 7 to 15 passenger capacity; $50 - 7 days for Original Manifest

entranceFees.title: Commercial Minibus, 16 to 25 passenger capacity
entranceFees.description: Minibus, 16 to 25 passenger capacity; $60 - 7 days for Original Manifest

entranceFees.title: Commercial Motorcoach, 26 or more passenger capacity
entranceFees.description: Motorcoach, 26 or more passenger capacity; $150 - 7 days for Original Manifest

entrancePasses.title: Badlands National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: This pass admits a single, private, non commercial vehicle and its occupants into the park. This pass does not include camping or give any type of discount at stores inside the park. Valid for one year from month of purchase.

entranceFees.title: Big Bend Entrance Fee--Per Vehicle
entranceFees.description: This fee includes all occupants of a private, non-commercial vehicle and is valid for 7 days.

entranceFees.title: Big Bend Entrance Fee--Motorcycle
entranceFees.description: Fee applicable to one motorcycle; valid for 7 days.

entranceFees.title: Big Bend Entrance Fee--Individual
entranceFees.description: Fee applicable to one individual walking in or bicycling in and is valid for 7 days.

entranceFees.title: Non-commercial groups with vehicle capacity 15 or less
entranceFees.description: Non-commercial groups with a vehicle capacity of 15 or less pay a per vehicle fee.

entranceFees.title: Non-commercial groups with vehicle capacity of 16 or more
entranceFees.description: $15 per person traveling in a non-commercial vehicle with a capacity of 16 or more. Fees will not exceed the commercial rate for the same sized vehicle. Youth 15 and younger are free. Individuals or families with a valid annual or lifetime pass may use their pass for themselves and up to 3 others.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Groups
entranceFees.description: Companies conducting business in the park are required to obtain a commercial use authorization. The only exception is companies travelling in a 26 person capacity or greater vehicle; such vehicles are charged a flat fee of $200 (commercial use authorization not required).

entrancePasses.title: Big Bend Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: The Big Bend Annual Pass covers entrance fees to Big Bend National Park. Pass is available at Big Bend National Park entrance stations or the Panther Junction Visitor Center. Pass is non-transferable.

entranceFees.title: No entrance fees.
entranceFees.description: The park has no entrance fees.

entrancePasses.title: No entrance fees.
entrancePasses.description: No entrance fees.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee - per vehicle
entranceFees.description: Covers all persons in a single, private, noncommercial vehicle and is valid for seven calendar days.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee - per motorcycle
entranceFees.description: Covers up to two people on a single motorcycle and is valid for seven calendar days.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee - per pedestrian or bicycle
entranceFees.description: Valid for seven calendar days.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee - commercial bus
entranceFees.description: Bus with 26 or more passenger seating capacity

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee - commercial bus
entranceFees.description: Bus with 7-25 passenger seating capacity

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee - commercial bus
entranceFees.description: Bus with 6 or less passenger seating capacity: $25 plus $7.00 per person

entrancePasses.title: Black Canyon Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: This pass admits the permit holder and all accompanying passengers in a single, private, noncommercial vehicle to the park. It is valid for 12 months from date of purchase and covers entry fees only.

entranceFees.title: Private Vehicle - Valid for 7 days
entranceFees.description: Admits private, non-commercial vehicle (15 passenger capacity or less) and all occupants to Bryce Canyon National Park. Includes unlimited use of the Shuttle during its operating season.

entranceFees.title: Per Person - Valid for 7 days
entranceFees.description: Admits one individual with no car to Bryce Canyon National Park. Typically used for bicyclists, hikers and pedestrians. Youth 15 and under are admitted free. Includes unlimited use of the Shuttle during its operating season.

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle - Valid for 7 days
entranceFees.description: Admits one non-commercial motorcycle to Bryce Canyon National Park. Includes unlimited use of the Shuttle during its operating season.

entranceFees.title: Road-based Commercial Tour (vehicle up to six seats)
entranceFees.description: Vehicle fee of $30 plus a per-person fee of $20 for those 16 years of age and older, not-to-exceed $50.

entranceFees.title: Road-based Commercial Tour (vehicle 7-15 seats, regardless of occupancy)
entranceFees.description: Flat fee.

entranceFees.title: Road-based Commercial Tour (vehicle 16-25 seats, regardless of occupancy)
entranceFees.description: Flat fee.

entranceFees.title: Road-based Commercial Tour (vehicle 26 or more seats, regardless of occupancy)
entranceFees.description: Flat fee.

entrancePasses.title: Bryce Canyon Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Valid for twelve months from the date of purchase, for unlimited visits to Bryce Canyon National Park. It admits the purchaser and any accompanying persons in a single, private, non-commercial vehicle, or the purchaser and accompanying immediate family (spouse, children, parents) when entry is by other means (shuttle, bicycle, and foot). This pass covers entrance fees only and is not refundable and/or transferable.

entrancePasses.title: Digital Entrance Pass
entrancePasses.description: Buy your pass in advance! Visit www.Recreation.gov and search for Bryce Canyon National Park Site Pass

entranceFees.title: Private Vehicle
entranceFees.description:
Admits one private, non-commercial vehicle 
(15 passenger capacity or less) and all its occupants.

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle
entranceFees.description: Admits a private, non-commercial motorcycle and its riders.

entranceFees.title: Per Person
entranceFees.description: Admits one individual with no car. Typically used for bicyclists, hikers, and pedestrians. Youth 15 and under are admitted free.

entrancePasses.title: Southeast Utah Parks Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Valid for one year through the month of purchase. Admits one (1) private, non-commercial vehicle or its pass holder to Arches and Canyonlands national parks, and Hovenweep and Natural Bridges national monuments.

entranceFees.title: Capitol Reef Entrance fee - Private Vehicle
entranceFees.description: The entrance fee for Capitol Reef National Park is paid into a self-serve tube at the beginning of the Scenic Drive, just past the campground. The cost includes all in a private vehicle. America the Beautiful Interagency passes cover this entrance fee.

entranceFees.title: Capitol Reef Entrance fee - Motorcycle
entranceFees.description: The entrance fee for Capitol Reef National Park is paid into a self-serve tube at the beginning of the Scenic Drive, just past the campground. The cost includes all on a single motorcycle. America the Beautiful Interagency passes cover this entrance fee.

entranceFees.title: Capitol Reef Entrance Fee - Bicycle and Pedestrian
entranceFees.description: The entrance fee for Capitol Reef National Park is paid into a self-serve tube at the beginning of the Scenic Drive, just past the campground.  America the Beautiful Interagency passes cover this entrance fee.

entranceFees.title: Capitol Reef Entrance Fee - Commercial vehicles with a seating capacity of 26 seats or greater
entranceFees.description: Buses and commercial vehicles are based on vehicle size/occupants. This fee can be paid at the visitor center.

entranceFees.title: Capitol Reef Entrance Fee - Commercial vehicles with a seating capacity of 7-25 seats
entranceFees.description: Buses and commercial vehicles are based on vehicle size/occupants. This fee can be paid at the visitor center.

entranceFees.title: Capitol Reef Entrance Fee - Commercial vehicles with a seating capacity of 1-6 seats
entranceFees.description: Buses and commercial vehicles are based on vehicle size/occupants. This fee can be paid at the visitor center.

entrancePasses.title: Capitol Reef Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: This pass covers the entrance fees to Capitol Reef National Park of the pass holder and occupants of a single, private non-commercial vehicle. It is valid for 365 days from the date of purchase. For information about other passes available see https://www.nps.gov/care/planyourvisit/fees.htm.

entranceFees.title: Adults (Per Person)
entranceFees.description: 16 years and older

entranceFees.title: Children
entranceFees.description: 15 years old and under

entranceFees.title: Entrance
entranceFees.description: There is no entrance fee to visit the Channel Islands National Park.

entranceFees.title: No Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: No Entrance Fee

entranceFees.title: Car - Summer (May 22 - October 31)
entranceFees.description: Admits one private, non-commercial vehicle (15 passenger capacity or less) and all occupants. Valid for 7 consecutive days.

entranceFees.title: Car - Winter (November 1 - May 21)
entranceFees.description: Admits one private, non-commercial vehicle (15 passenger capacity or less) and all occupants. Valid for 7 consecutive days.

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle - Summer (May 22 - October 31)
entranceFees.description: Admits one or two passengers on a private, non-commercial motorcycle. Valid for 7 consecutive days.

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle - Winter (November 1 - May 21)
entranceFees.description: Admits one or two passengers on a private, non-commercial motorcycle. Valid for 7 consecutive days.  Valid for 7 consecutive days.

entranceFees.title: Bicyclist, Hiker, Pedestrian with no car
entranceFees.description: Admits one individual with no car (bicyclist, hiker, pedestrian). Youth 15 and under are admitted free of charge. Valid for 7 consecutive days.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Vehicles (Capacity of 1 to 6 passengers)
entranceFees.description:
Commercial vehicles with a capacity of 1 to 6 passengers are required to pay a $30 entrance fee, plus a $15 per passenger fee.

The entrance fee structure for commercial vehicles visiting national parks is based on the capacity of the vehicle you arrive in, not the
number of passengers. This fee is valid for 7 consecutive days with the same company and the same passengers.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Vehicles (Capacity of 7 to 15 passengers)
entranceFees.description:
The entrance fee structure for commercial vehicles visiting national parks is based on the capacity of the vehicle you arrive in, not the
number of passengers. This fee is valid for 7 consecutive days with the same company and the same passengers.

entranceFees.title: Commerical Vehicles (Capacity of 16 to 25 passengers)
entranceFees.description:
The entrance fee structure for commercial vehicles visiting national parks is based on the capacity of the vehicle you arrive in, not the
number of passengers. This fee is valid for 7 consecutive days with the same company and the same passengers.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Vehicles (Capacity of 26 or more passengers)
entranceFees.description:
The entrance fee structure for commercial vehicles visiting national parks is based on the capacity of the vehicle you arrive in, not the
number of passengers. This fee is valid for 7 consecutive days with the same company and the same passengers.

entrancePasses.title: Crater Lake Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Valid only at Crater Lake National Park and Lava Beds National Monument. The Crater Lake annual pass is good for one year from the issue month. It admits the pass owner and accompanying passengers in a single, private, noncommercial vehicle or pass owner and three persons when entry is by other means.

entranceFees.title: Entrance
entranceFees.description: There is no entrance fee.

entranceFees.title: Death Valley Entrance Fee - per vehicle
entranceFees.description: This permit allows all persons traveling with the permit holder in one single private, non-commercial vehicle (car/truck/van) to leave and re-enter the park as many times as they wish during the 7-day period from the date of purchase.

entranceFees.title: Death Valley Entrance Fee - per motorcycle
entranceFees.description: This permit allows persons traveling on one motorcycle to leave and re-enter the park as many times as they wish during the 7-day period from the date of purchase.

entranceFees.title: Death Valley Entrance Fee - per individual
entranceFees.description: This permit allows a single individual traveling on foot or individuals traveling on one bicycle to leave and re-enter the park as many times as they wish during the 7-day period from the date of purchase.

entrancePasses.title: Death Valley Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Annual pass providing free entrance to Death Valley for 12 months from the date of purchase

entranceFees.title: Denali Individual Weekly Pass
entranceFees.description: Admits one individual, 16 years and up.

entranceFees.title: Denali Annual Pass
entranceFees.description: This pass is valid for 12 months from the date of purchase. The pass covers the cardholder plus up to three fellow travelers. Up to two names can be written on the pass, meaning it can be used by either cardholder.

entranceFees.title: Dry Tortugas Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description:
This fee covers entrance to the park for 7 days. If you are arriving via seaplane or ferry the travel ticket includes entrance fee to Dry Tortugas National Park and Fort Jefferson. If you hold a National Parks Pass, show your pass at check-in and the entrance fee will be deducted from your transportation cost.

If you are arriving via private boat or private seaplane fees are collected through a self-service fee area on the main dock at Garden Key. Cash or check only.

entrancePasses.title: Entrance Passes
entrancePasses.description:
Enjoy the convenience of purchasing an digital pass on Recreation.gov before you arrive. You have immediate access to your digital pass and can easily download it on your phone or tablet. Your pass will also be emailed as a PDF and can be printed out for display when you arrive.

To purchase online go to https://www.recreation.gov/sitepass/2665

entranceFees.title: Everglades National Park Entrance Fee- Per vehicle
entranceFees.description: The entrance fee to the Everglades National Park is good for 7 consecutive days starting from the day of purchase.

entranceFees.title: Everglades National Park Entrance Fee- Per Person/Cyclist/Paddlecraft
entranceFees.description: The Everglades National Park charges an entry fee per person when an individual enters the main entrance station through a bike or by walking. The entrance fee is good for 7 consecutive days starting from the day of purchase. Individuals 16 years old and younger, are admitted free of charge.

entranceFees.title: Everglades National Park Entrance Fee- Per Motorcycle
entranceFees.description: The Everglades National Park entrance fee for motorcycles is good for 7 consecutive days starting from the day of purchase.

entranceFees.title: Everglades National Park Entrance Fee-  Commercial Motorcoach
entranceFees.description:
Entrance fees to the Everglades National Park are charged based on the seating capacity of the vehicle.

Motorcoach (26 or more passengers)

entranceFees.title: Everglades National Park Entrance Fee- Commercial Minibus
entranceFees.description:
Entrance fees to the Everglades National Park are charged based on the seating capacity of the vehicle.

Minibus (16-25 passengers)

entranceFees.title: Everglades National Park Entrance Fee- Commercial Van
entranceFees.description:
Entrance fees to the Everglades National Park are charged based on the seating capacity of the vehicle.

Van (7- 15 passengers)

entranceFees.title: Everglades National Park Entrance Fee- Commercial Sedan
entranceFees.description:
Entrance fees to the Everglades National Park are charged based on the seating capacity of the vehicle.

Sedan (1-6 passengers: $15 per person)

entrancePasses.title: Everglades National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: The Annual Pass for the Everglades National Park is valid for 12 months starting from the day of purchase and is good for unlimited visits to the park during this period. These passes can be purchased at the Homestead and Shark Valley entrance stations or the Gulf Coast and Flamingo Visitor Centers. You can also purchase the senior park pass or pass for entry into all national parks at these locations.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: There is no entrance fee for Gates of the Arctic.

entranceFees.title: Tram Ride to the Top
entranceFees.description: Tickets to ride to the top of the iconic arch are available at gatewayarch.com. Prices vary from $11-$19 based on visitor age, date of visit, and whether visitors have a park pass (America the Beautiful passes earn a $3 discount).

entranceFees.title: Museum under the Gateway Arch
entranceFees.description: Admission to our museum, cafe, and gift store is free for all visitors.

entranceFees.title: Documentary Movie
entranceFees.description: How did they build it? Come see the award-winning film Monument to the Dream and find out! The film documents the construction and meaning of the Gateway Arch and is shown daily at Tucker Theater in the Gateway Arch Visitor Center. The film is a half hour long, and America the Beautiful park pass holders get a $3 discount.

entranceFees.title: No Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: There is no entrance fee to enter Glacier Bay National Park and Preserve.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee by private vehicle - 7 day permit (summer)
entranceFees.description: This is a entrance fee for all persons traveling in a single, private, non-commercial vehicle (car/truck/van). The permit is non-transferable. Visitors can enter the park at any time, if the entrance station is not staffed, a self-registration area is available for purchasing a 7-day park permit.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee by single entry (summer)
entranceFees.description: This is a per person entrance fee for a visitor traveling on foot, bicycle, or for individuals traveling together in a vehicle as a non-commercial, organized group. The permit is non-transferable.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee by motorcycle
entranceFees.description: This is a per motorcycle entrance fee. The permit is non-transferable.

entranceFees.title: Going-to-the-Sun Road Entry Reservation Ticket
entranceFees.description: Glacier National Park has instituted an online vehicle reservation system for the Going-to-the-Sun Road, the North Fork, Two Medicine, and Many Glacier during peak season.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee by private vehicle - 7 day permit (winter)
entranceFees.description:
This is a entrance fee for all persons traveling in a single, private, non-commercial vehicle (car/truck/van). The permit is non-transferable. Visitors can enter the park at any time, if the entrance station is not staffed, a self-registration area is available for purchasing a 7-day park permit.

The winter rate is charged from November 1 to April 30.

entranceFees.title: Entrance fee by single entry (winter)
entranceFees.description:
This is a per person entrance fee for a visitor traveling on foot, bicycle, or for individuals traveling together in a vehicle as a non-commercial, organized group. The permit is non-transferable.

The winter rate is charged from November 1 to April 30.

entranceFees.title: Entry Fee by motorcycle (winter)
entranceFees.description:
This is a per motorcycle entrance fee. The permit is non-transferable.

The winter rate is charged from November 1 to April 30.

entrancePasses.title: Glacier National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: This pass is valid for one year from the month of entry and admits the purchaser and passengers in a single, private, non-commercial vehicle, or the pass holder and his/her immediate family (spouse, children, parents) when entry is by other means (foot, bicycle) into the park. It is nontransferable, nonrefundable, and does not cover camping fees.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: This pass is valid for one year from the month of entry and admits the purchaser and passengers in a single, private, non-commercial vehicle, or the pass holder and his/her immediate family (spouse, children, parents) when entry is by other means (foot, bicycle) into the park. It is nontransferable, nonrefundable, does not cover camping fees and  cannot be replaced if lost or stolen.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful Senior Lifetime Pass
entrancePasses.description: Available for U.S. citizens or permanent residents age 62 or over. Applicants must provide documentation of age and residency or citizenship.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful Senior Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description:
Available for U.S. citizens or permanent residents age 62 or over. Applicants must provide documentation of age and residency or citizenship.
This pass is only valid for one year. Four Annual Senior Passes may be exchanged for a free Lifetime Senior Pass.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful Every Kid Outdoors Pass
entrancePasses.description:
Free to U.S. 4th Graders (including home-schooled and free-choice learners 10 years of age).
Valid for the duration of the 4th grade school year (September - August).
Students must have a paper voucher printed from the Every Kid Outdoors to obtain the Annual 4th Grade Pass. Digital versions of the voucher (such as smart phones or tablets) will not be accepted.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful Access Pass
entrancePasses.description: This is a lifetime pass for U.S. citizens or permanent residents with permanent disabilities. Documentation is required to obtain the pass. Acceptable documentation includes: statement by a licensed physician; document issued by Federal agency such as the Veteran's Administration, Social Security Disability Income or Supplemental Security Income; or document issued by a State agency such as a vocational rehabilitation agency.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful Military Pass
entrancePasses.description:
Available to active duty military personnel and dependents, veterans and Gold Star Families with proper identification (CAC Card or DD Form 1173, VHIC, Veteran ID Card or Gold Star Family access voucher).
The pass admits the pass owners and any accompanying passengers in a private non-commercial vehicle at per vehicle fee areas, or the pass owner and up to additional 3 adults at sites that charge per person.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful Volunteer Pass
entrancePasses.description:
This pass is for volunteers acquiring 250 service hours on a cumulative basis. It provides access to, and use of, Federal recreation sites that charge an Entrance or Standard Amenity Fee for a year, beginning from the date of award.

Contact our Volunteer Coordinator at 406-888-7851 to learn about volunteer opportunities in Glacier or visit volunteer.gov.

entranceFees.title: Grand Canyon National Park Vehicle Permit
entranceFees.description: Admits one single, private, non-commercial vehicle and all its passengers. Organized groups are not eligible for the vehicle permit.

entranceFees.title: Grand Canyon National Park Motorcycle Permit
entranceFees.description: Admits one single, private, non-commercial motorcycle and its passenger(s).

entranceFees.title: Grand Canyon National Park Individual Permit
entranceFees.description: Admits one individual when entering by foot, bicycle, park shuttle bus, Grand Canyon Railway and private rafting trip. Individuals 15 years old and younger are admitted free of charge.

entrancePasses.title: Grand Canyon National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Valid for twelve months from the date of purchase, for unlimited visits to Grand Canyon National Park. It admits the purchaser and any accompanying persons in a single, private, non-commercial vehicle, or the purchaser and accompanying immediate family (spouse, children, parents) when entry is by other means (train, shuttle, bicycle, and foot).

entranceFees.title: Grand Teton Entrance Fee - Private Vehicle
entranceFees.description: Park entrance fee for 7 days for a private, non-commercial vehicle.

entranceFees.title: Grand Teton Entrance Fee - Motorcycle
entranceFees.description: Park entrance for 7 days per private motorcycle.

entranceFees.title: Grand Teton Entrance Fee - Hiker/Biker
entranceFees.description: Park entrance fee for 7 days for each visitor 16 years and older entering by foot, bicycle, ski, etc.

entrancePasses.title: Grand Teton Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Pass is valid for one year through the month of purchase. Park Annual Pass provides entrance to pass holder and accompanying passengers in a single private non-commercial vehicle to Grand Teton National Park. Purchase your pass at one of Grand Teton's park entrances and permits desks at the Craig Thomas Discovery and Visitor Center and the Colter Bay Visitor Center.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fees
entranceFees.description: Great Basin National Park has no entrance fees.

entranceFees.title: Non-Commercial Vehicle and Occupants
entranceFees.description: Passenger vehicle with all occupants; fee valid for 7 days.

entranceFees.title: Oversized Vehicle, 15+ passengers, age 16+
entranceFees.description: Per passenger, 16 years and older in oversized vehicle, including 15 passenger vans, small buses, etc. Valid for 7 days. Passengers under 16 are free.

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle and Riders
entranceFees.description: One motorcycle and all its riders; valid for 7 days.

entrancePasses.title: Great Sand Dunes Annual Family Pass
entrancePasses.description: Covers one family's entrance for 12 months from time of purchase. Valid for two adults with signatures plus others in vehicle.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description:
An entrance fee of $10 per person (16 years of age and older) is required; entrance fees/passes permit 1-7 consecutive days of use in this national park.

Holders of the Annual, Senior, Military, 4th grade and Access Pass can bring in 3 adults free of charge under their pass. Any pass must be displayed in a vehicle while in the national park.

entrancePasses.title: Guadalupe Mountains National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: This pass is valid for entrance into Guadalupe Mountains National Park for one year from the month of purchase. The pass admits up to four adults in a private vehicle and is non-transferable; visitors under 16 years of age are free. You can purchase this pass at the Pine Springs Visitor Center.

entranceFees.title: Haleakalā National Park Private Vehicle (14 pax capacity or less) Entry Fee
entranceFees.description: Entry Fee is valid for 3 days starting from the day of purchase. Please use credit cards for payment of entry fees at the Summit and Kīpahulu entrance stations. All park visitors are required to purchase a recreational use pass upon entering Haleakalā National Park. Passes are non-transferable.

entranceFees.title: Haleakalā National Park Private Motorcycle Entry Fee
entranceFees.description: Entry Fee is valid for 3 days starting from the day of purchase. Please use credit cards for payment of entry fees at the Summit and Kīpahulu entrance stations. All park visitors are required to purchase a recreational use pass upon entering Haleakalā National Park. Passes are non-transferable.

entranceFees.title: Haleakalā National Park Per Person Entry Fee; includes bicyclists, walk-ins, hikers
entranceFees.description: This fee is for visitors entering the park on a bicycle or on foot. Entry Fee is valid for 3 days starting from the day of purchase. Please use credit cards for payment of entry fees at the Summit and Kīpahulu entrance stations. All park visitors are required to purchase a recreational use pass upon entering Haleakalā National Park. Passes are non-transferable.

entranceFees.title: Haleakalā Natonal Park Non-Commercial Organized Groups Fee; Scouts, Rotary, Clubs, Youth Groups, Churches, Reunions
entranceFees.description: Organized groups that do not qualify for Educational Fee Waivers are charged as follows: $25.00 Non-commercial vehicles with a vehicle capacity of 14 or less. $12.00 per person Non-commercial vehicles with a capacity of 15 or greater. Youth 15 and under are free. Individuals or families with any valid Annual or Lifetime pass may use their pass for entry at the per person rate. Pass and photo ID must be present upon entry.

entrancePasses.title: Hawai‘i Tri-Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Valid for 12 months from purchase date. Admits the pass holder/s and passengers in a non-commercial vehicle (14 pax capacity or less) to Haleakala National Park, Hawai‘i Volcanoes National Park and Pu`uhonua O Hōnaunau National Historical Park. All other National Parks in Hawai‘i are free entry.

entranceFees.title: Hawai‘i Volcanoes National Park - Private Vehicle
entranceFees.description: Admits one private non-commercial vehicle (capacity 15 or less) and all of its passengers. Valid for 7 days. Organized non-profit groups, (service organizations, scouts, church groups, college/school clubs) are not eligible.

entranceFees.title: Hawai‘i Volcanoes National Park - Motorcycle
entranceFees.description: Per motorcycle - Valid for 7 days

entranceFees.title: Hawai‘i Volcanoes National Park - Bicycle
entranceFees.description: Per bicycle - Valid for 7 days

entranceFees.title: Hawai‘i Volcanoes National Park - Individual
entranceFees.description: Per walk-in pedestrian - valid for 7 days

entranceFees.title: Hawai‘i Volcanoes National Park - Groups
entranceFees.description: Non-commercial groups entering the park in a bus or vehicle with a capacity of 16 persons or more will be charged $15.00 for each person on board. Exceptions: Anyone who is 15 or younger is exempt from paying an entrance fee. Passes may be used for entry as defined on the back of the pass. In many cases the driver will have been hired for transportation only and is exempt from paying the entrance fee. The total fee charged will not exceed the equivalent commercial fee for that type of vehicle.

entrancePasses.title: Hawai‘i Tri-Park Pass
entrancePasses.description: An annual tri-park pass allows access for 1 full year from date of first use at Hawai‘i Volcanoes National Park, Haleakalā National Park, and Pu‘uhonua o Hōnaunau National Historical Park.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fees
entranceFees.description: Entrance Fees

entranceFees.title: Historic Museum
entranceFees.description: Fordyce Museum

entranceFees.title: Guided Tours
entranceFees.description: Guided Tours

entranceFees.title: 7-Day Park Entrance Pass - Family-Size Vehicle
entranceFees.description: Per private family-sized vehicle (valid for 1-7 days from date of purchase).

entranceFees.title: 7-Day Park Entrance Pass - Motorcycle Fee
entranceFees.description: Per motorcycle (valid for 1-7 days from date of purchase)

entranceFees.title: 7-Day Per Person Entrance Pass (Organized, non-commercial groups)
entranceFees.description: Visitors 16 years of age or older who enter on foot, bicycle, boat, or as part of an organized group not involved in a commercial tour.

entrancePasses.title: Indiana Dunes National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: This pass provides entry for the pass owner(s) and passengers in a family-sized vehicle.  This pass only works at the Indiana Dunes National Park and is not accepted at the Indiana Dunes State Park.

entranceFees.title: Isle Royale Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description:
The daily entrance fee is  $7 per person. It is charged to enter or remain within the park per calendar day (it includes the day you arrive and the day you depart the park). Pay this fee after your transportation reservations have been confirmed. 

All Federal Recreation Passes (Annual, Senior, Access, Military) are honored. Entrance fees will be waived for the pass holder and up to 3 adults traveling with the pass holder.

Children ages 15 and under are exempt from paying entrance fees.

entrancePasses.title: Isle Royale Season Pass
entrancePasses.description: Valid from April 16 - October 31 of the year indicated. Covers the entrance fee ($7 per person per day) for the person whose signature appears on the pass and up to 3 adults (aged 16 and up) traveling with the pass holder. Non-refundable and non-transferable. Can be obtained in-person from the Houghton, Rock Harbor, or Windigo Visitor Centers or online at www.pay.gov, search Isle Royale Season Pass and click on "Continue to Form."

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: 7-day vehicle permit, admitting the passengers of a single, non-commercial vehicle on the day of purchase and for the next six days.

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: 7-day entrance permit, per motorcycle.

entranceFees.title: Individual Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: 7-day entrance fee, per person on foot or bike.

entrancePasses.title: Joshua Tree National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: This pass is valid for 12 months from the month of purchase. It covers the entrance fee to Joshua Tree National Park for the pass signee and accompanying passengers entering in a single, non-commercial vehicle. Joshua Tree Annual Passes are available at park entrance stations and visitor centers.

entranceFees.title: Katmai National Park and Preserve
entranceFees.description: There is no entrance fee for Katmai.

entrancePasses.title: None
entrancePasses.description: No entrance passes are necessary to enter Katmai.

entranceFees.title: No Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: No entrance fees are charged at Kenai Fjords National Park

entranceFees.title: Free Entrance
entranceFees.description: There is no entrance fee to visit Kobuk Valley National Park

entranceFees.title: Lake Clark Entrance and User Fees
entranceFees.description:
You do not need to pay fees, make reservations, or obtain permits from the National Park Service for any recreational activities in the park including backpacking, camping, river running, bear viewing, or visiting Dick Proenneke's cabin.

Information regarding hunting and fishing license requirements, voluntary backcountry registration forms, and the permits commercial film crews or scientists conducting research and collecting items need to obtain are available on the Permits & Reservations page.

entrancePasses.title: None
entrancePasses.description: No entrance passes are necessary to enter Lake Clark National Park and Preserve.

entranceFees.title: Winter Pass
entranceFees.description: Valid for 1-7 days at Lassen Volcanic National Park between December 1 and April 15.

entranceFees.title: Vehicle Pass
entranceFees.description: Valid for 1-7 days at Lassen Volcanic National Park between April 16 and November 30

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle Pass
entranceFees.description: Valid for one motorcycle regardless of the amount of passengers. Valid for 7 days at Lassen Volcanic National Park.

entranceFees.title: Individual Entrance Pass
entranceFees.description: Per person entrance fee for a visitor traveling on foot, bicycle, or for individuals traveling together in a vehicle as a non-commercial, organized group.Valid for 7 days at Lassen Volcanic National Park.

entrancePasses.title: Lassen Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Valid for one year from month of purchase at Lassen Volcanic National Park and Whiskeytown National Recreation Area. Passes may be purchased as park entrance stations mid-May through October.

entranceFees.title: Park Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: Entry to Mammoth Cave National Park and its surface features is free of charge. There is, however, a charge to tour the cave. Cave tour prices vary.

entranceFees.title: Mesa Verde Entrance Fee - Per Vehicle - Summer Season
entranceFees.description:
This is a per-vehicle entrance fee for the summer season (May 1 to October 22). It is valid for seven days from the day of purchase.

Please note that we offer fee waivers for qualified education groups. Visit http://www.nps.gov/meve/learn/education/feewaiver_info.htm to learn more.

entranceFees.title: Mesa Verde Entrance Fee - Per Motorcycle - Summer Season
entranceFees.description: This is a per-motorcycle entrance fee for the summer season (May 1 to October 22). It is valid for seven days from the day of purchase.

entranceFees.title: Mesa Verde Entrance Fee - Per Person - Summer Season
entranceFees.description: This is a per-person (bicyclist and individual) entrance fee for the summer season (May 1 to October 22). It is valid for seven days from the day of purchase.

entranceFees.title: Mesa Verde Entrance Fee - Per Vehicle - Fall/Winter/Spring
entranceFees.description:
This is a per-vehicle entrance fee for fall/winter/spring (January 2 to April 30 and October 23 to December 31). It is valid for seven days from the day of purchase.

Please note that we offer fee waivers for qualified education groups. Visit http://www.nps.gov/meve/learn/education/feewaiver_info.htm to learn more.

entranceFees.title: Mesa Verde Entrance Fee - Per Motorcycle - Fall/Winter/Spring
entranceFees.description: This is a per-vehicle entrance fee for fall/winter/spring (January 2 to April 30 and October 23 to December 31). It is valid for seven days from the day of purchase.

entranceFees.title: Mesa Verde Entrance Fee - Per Person - Fall/Winter/Spring
entranceFees.description: This is a per-person (bicyclist and individual) entrance fee for fall/winter/spring (January 2 to April 30 and October 23 to December 31). It is valid for seven days from the day of purchase.

entrancePasses.title: Mesa Verde Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: The annual pass provides entrance into Mesa Verde National Park for a year, beginning from the date of sale. It covers the entrance fee for the pass holder and anyone in their vehicle.

entranceFees.title: Mount Rainier Single Vehicle Fee
entranceFees.description: Grants unlimited entry for one vehicle and passengers for seven consecutive days. Vehicle must be private, noncommercial, and with a seating capacity of 15 or less.

entranceFees.title: Mount Rainier "Per Person" Fee
entranceFees.description: Walk-up or single bicycle fee. Grants unlimited entry for seven consecutive days.

entranceFees.title: Mount Rainier Motorcycle Fee
entranceFees.description: Grants unlimited entry for one motorcycle and passenger for seven consecutive days.

entranceFees.title: Mount Rainier Campground Fee
entranceFees.description: Fee per site, nightly, for camping in Cougar Rock, Ohanapecosh, and White River campgrounds. Learn more about camping at Mount Rainier at https://www.nps.gov/mora/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm

entranceFees.title: Mount Rainier Campground Fee - Groups
entranceFees.description: Fee for group sites, nightly, in Cougar Rock and Ohanapecosh campgrounds. Group sites accommodate 25 to 40 people depending on site. There are no group sites in White River Campground. For more information about camping at Mount Rainier: https://www.nps.gov/mora/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm

entrancePasses.title: Mount Rainier Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Grants unlimited entry for one year to pass owner and passengers in the same car.

entranceFees.title: Fees or reservations
entranceFees.description: No fees or reservations are required to visit the national park.

entrancePasses.title: Entrance Pass
entrancePasses.description: Since there are no fees or reservations required, entrance passes are all waived.

entranceFees.title: National Parks of New York Harbor Entrance Fees
entranceFees.description: While none of the eleven parks of the National Parks of New York Harbor charge an entrance fee, some parks may charge a fee for certain amenities such as parking or camping. Be sure to visit the park specific webpage to learn more about site specific fees.

entrancePasses.title: NPNH Entrance Pass
entrancePasses.description: While none of the eleven parks within the National Parks of New York charge an entrance fee, some parks may charge for certain amenities such as parking at beach areas and camping. Be sure to check the park specific webpage to learn more about fees they may charge if you are interested in visiting.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: New River Gorge National Park and Preserve does not charge an entrance fee.

entrancePasses.title: Passes
entrancePasses.description: Since this is not a fee park, park passes, senior passes, and access passes are not available for purchase here. If you plan to visit other national parks with an entrance fee, passes can be purchased online at www.nps.gov, or at any park that charges an entrance fee.

entranceFees.title: North Cascades National Park Service Complex Entrance Fees
entranceFees.description: North Cascades National Park Service Complex does not charge entrance fees.

entrancePasses.title: North Cascades National Park Service Complex Entrance Passes
entrancePasses.description: North Cascades National Park Service Complex does not sell entrance passes because no entry fee is required to enjoy the park.

entranceFees.title: Vehicle (Non-Commercial)
entranceFees.description: Valid for seven consecutive days. Applies to private, non-commercial vehicles (15 passenger capacity or less). The pass covers all vehicle occupants.

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle
entranceFees.description: Valid for seven consecutive days. Fee admits one individual on a private, non-commercial motorcycle.

entranceFees.title: Per Person and Bicyclists
entranceFees.description: Valid for seven consecutive days. This fee admits one person without a vehicle, including hikers, bicyclists, and pedestrians. Individuals fifteen years or younger are admitted free of charge.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Van (7-15 seats)
entranceFees.description: A commercial tour is defined as persons traveling on an itinerary that has been packaged, priced or sold for leisure recreational purposes by an organization that realizes financial gain through the provisions of the service.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Minibus (16-25 seats)
entranceFees.description: A commercial tour is defined as persons traveling on an itinerary that has been packaged, priced or sold for leisure recreational purposes by an organization that realizes financial gain through the provisions of the service.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Motor-coach (26 seats or more)
entranceFees.description: A commercial tour is defined as persons traveling on an itinerary that has been packaged, priced or sold for leisure recreational purposes by an organization that realizes financial gain through the provisions of the service.

entranceFees.title: Non-Commercial Organized Group Vehicles 15 seats or less
entranceFees.description: Applies to organized groups such as Scouts, Rotary, Youth Groups, Churches, Clubs and Reunions etc. Youth 15 and under are admitted free of charge.

entrancePasses.title: Olympic National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: The Olympic National Park Annual Pass costs $55 and is good for entry into the park for one year from the month of purchase. Passes can be purchased at Olympic National Park visitor centers and entrance stations.

entranceFees.title: Auto/7-day pass to Petrified Forest National Park
entranceFees.description: Fee is for one private vehicle and the people within for 7 days.

entranceFees.title: Bicycle and walkers/per person
entranceFees.description: The fee allows for one person walking or one person on a bicycle into the park for 7 days.

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle (flat fee)
entranceFees.description: Allows a motorcycle and riders in for 7 days.

entranceFees.title: Large commercial tour bus with capacity of 26 or more
entranceFees.description: Large commercial tour bus with capacity of 26 or more: $150 (for 7 days)

entranceFees.title: Small commercial tour bus with capacity of 16-25
entranceFees.description: Small commercial tour bus with capacity of 16-25: $60 (for 7 days)

entranceFees.title: Commercial tour van with capacity of 7-15
entranceFees.description: Commercial tour van with capacity of 7-15: $50 (for 7 days)

entranceFees.title: Van with capacity of 7-15
entranceFees.description: Commercial tour van with capacity of 7-15: $50 (for 7 days)

entranceFees.title: Commercial tour passenger vehicle with capacity of 1-6
entranceFees.description: Commercial tour passenger vehicle with capacity of 1-6: $25-$50 (for 7 days) depending on occupancy.

entrancePasses.title: Petrified Forest National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Good for a private vehicle and its occupants for a year.

Visitors 16 years and older (i.e. service organizations, scouts, church groups, and college/school clubs) in buses and vehicles with 16 passenger capacity or more.

entranceFees.description: 7 days for original manifest

entranceFees.title: Commercial Tour Bus or Motorcoach, 26 or more passenger capacity

entrancePasses.title: U.S. Military Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description:
Available to U.S. military members and dependents in the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, Reserve, and National Guard members.
Must be obtained in person at a Federal recreation site by showing a Common Access Card (CAC) or Military ID (Form 1173).

entrancePasses.title: Senior Inter-Agency Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description:
For U.S. citizens or permanent residents age 62 or over. Applicants must provide documentation of age and residency or citizenship.
May provide a 50 percent discount on some amenity fees. Does NOT cover or reduce special recreation permit fees or fees charged by concessionaires.

entrancePasses.title: Pinnacles National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Admits the purchaser and their passengers in a single, private, non-commercial vehicle or the pass holder and their companions when entry is by other means (i.e. foot, bicycle). Nontransferable, nonrefundable, and does not cover camping fees.

entrancePasses.title: Annual Inter-Agency Pass
entrancePasses.description: Can be obtained in person at a federal recreation site, or by calling 1-888-ASK USGS (1-888-275-8747), Ext. 3 (Hours of operation are: 8:00 am to 4:00 pm Mountain time). Or online by visiting the USGS store. http://store.usgs.gov/ This Pass is non-transferable.

entrancePasses.title: Senior Inter-Agency Lifetime Pass
entrancePasses.description:
For U.S. citizens or permanent residents age 62 or over. Applicants must provide documentation of age and residency or citizenship.
May provide a 50 percent discount on some amenity fees. Does NOT cover or reduce special recreation permit fees or fees charged by concessionaires.

entrancePasses.title: Access Pass
entrancePasses.description: U.S. citizens or permanent residents with permanent disabilities. Applicants must provide documentation of permanent disability and residency or citizenship.

entrancePasses.title: Every Kid Outdoors Pass
entrancePasses.description: For U.S. 4th graders (including home-schooled and free-choice learners 10 years of age).

entranceFees.title: 1-Day Vehicle Entrance Pass
entranceFees.description:
Valid for date of purchase. Covers single, non-commercial vehicle with capacity of less than 16 passengers. 

Purchasing at the park's entrance stations? Credit/debit cards only.

Visitors with cash only may purchase park entrance passes from the Rocky Mountain Conservancy Nature Store located at Beaver Meadows, Fall River, or Kawuneeche Visitor Centers.

entranceFees.title: 1-Day Per Person Entrance Pass
entranceFees.description:
Valid for date of purchase. Applies to walk-ins, bicycles, and non-commercial groups.

Purchasing at the park's entrance stations? Credit/debit cards only.

Visitors with cash only may purchase park entrance passes from the Rocky Mountain Conservancy Nature Store located at Beaver Meadows, Fall River, or Kawuneeche Visitor Centers.

entranceFees.title: 1-Day Motorcycle Entrance Pass
entranceFees.description:
Valid for date of purchase. Covers one motorcycle.

Purchasing at the park's entrance stations? Credit/debit cards only.

Visitors with cash only may purchase park entrance passes from the Rocky Mountain Conservancy Nature Store located at Beaver Meadows, Fall River, or Kawuneeche Visitor Centers.

entranceFees.title: 7-Day Vehicle Entrance Pass
entranceFees.description:
Rocky Entrance Fee - vehicle entrance pass valid for 7 consecutive days

Purchasing at the park's entrance stations? Credit/debit cards only.

Visitors with cash only may purchase park entrance passes from the Rocky Mountain Conservancy Nature Store located at Beaver Meadows, Fall River, or Kawuneeche Visitor Centers.

entranceFees.title: 7-Day Motorcycle Entrance Pass
entranceFees.description:
Rocky Entrance Fee - motorcycle entrance pass valid for 7 consecutive days.

Purchasing at the park's entrance stations? Credit/debit cards only.

Visitors with cash only may purchase park entrance passes from the Rocky Mountain Conservancy Nature Store located at Beaver Meadows, Fall River, or Kawuneeche Visitor Centers.

entrancePasses.title: Rocky Mountain National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description:
Unlimited entry for one year from date of purchase. 

Purchasing at the park's entrance stations? Credit/debit cards only.

Visitors with cash only may purchase park entrance passes from the Rocky Mountain Conservancy Nature Store located at Beaver Meadows, Fall River, or Kawuneeche Visitor Centers.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful Interagency Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description:
This pass covers the entrance fee to all national parks, as well as USFWS and also standard amenity fees (day use fees) at lands managed by the US Forest Service, Bureau of Land Management, Bureau of Reclamation, and US Army Corps of Engineers.

Purchasing at the park's entrance stations? Credit/debit cards only.

Visitors with cash only may purchase park entrance passes from the Rocky Mountain Conservancy Nature Store located at Beaver Meadows, Fall River, or Kawuneeche Visitor Centers

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful Interagency Senior Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description:
Available for: US citizens or permanent residents ages 62 or over. Applicants must provide documentation of age and residency or citizenship.

Purchasing at the park's entrance stations? Credit/debit cards only.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful Interagency Senior Lifetime Pass
entrancePasses.description:
Available for: US citizens or permanent residents ages 62 or over. Applicants must provide documentation of age and residency or citizenship.

Purchasing at the park's entrance stations? Credit/debit cards only.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful Access Pass
entrancePasses.description: Available for: US citizens or permanent residents with permanent disabilities. Applicants must provide documentation of permanent disability and residency or citizenship. This pass is valid for the passholder's lifetime.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful Military Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Available for current US military members and their dependents in the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, Coast Guard, and Space Force, as well as Reserve and National Guard members. Please check photo ID requirements before arriving.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful Military Lifetime Pass
entrancePasses.description: Available for Gold Star Families with a valid Gold Star Family Voucher and US military veterans with a valid, veteran ID.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful 4th Grade Pass
entrancePasses.description: Available for US 4th graders, including home-schooled and free-choice learners 10 years of age, with a valid Every Kid Outdoors paper voucher

entranceFees.title: Saguaro National Park Vehicle Weekly Pass
entranceFees.description: Admits one single, private, non-commercial vehicle or RV and all its passengers. Organized groups are not eligible for the vehicle permit.

entranceFees.title: Saguaro National Park Individual Weekly Pass
entranceFees.description: Admits one individual when entering by foot or bicycle. Individuals 15 years or younger are admitted free of charge.

entranceFees.title: Saguaro National Park Motorcycle Weekly Pass
entranceFees.description: Admits one motorcycle and its riders.

entranceFees.title: Saguaro National Park Annual Pass
entranceFees.description: Covers up to four adults. Individuals 15 years or younger are admitted free of charge.

entrancePasses.title: Saguaro National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description:
Valid for 12 months from the date of purchase, for unlimited visits to Saguaro National Park, in Tucson, Arizona.   May be purchased at either district or online from www.nps.gov/sagu/payfee.htm.

Admits purchaser and any accompanying persons in a single, private, non-commercial vehicle, or pass holder and three persons (16 & older) where per person entrance fees are charged. This passport covers entrance fees only and is not refundable and/or transferable.

entranceFees.title: Vehicle Pass
entranceFees.description: This pass is valid for 1-7 days and includes everyone traveling in a single vehicle for Sequoia & Kings Canyon National Parks and Hume Lake District of Sequoia National Forest/Giant Sequoia National Monument.

entranceFees.title: Individual Entry Pass
entranceFees.description: This entry fee is for a single person traveling on foot or by bicycle. It is valid for 1-7 days in Sequoia & Kings Canyon National Parks and Hume Lake District of Sequoia National Forest/Giant Sequoia National Monument.

entranceFees.title: Non-Commercial Group
entranceFees.description: Groups traveling in a bus or vehicle with a capacity of 16 persons or more are charged per person. People 15 years old or younger, drivers hired for transportation only, or anyone with a pass that may be used for park entry is exempt from paying the entrance fee.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Group, 1-6 Passenger Capacity - $20 per passenger - plus entrance fee
entranceFees.description: The charge for vehicles with a seating capacity of 1-6 passengers is $25 plus $20 per person, with a maximum total charge of $75. This entrance fee is for commercial tours of one or more people traveling on an itinerary that has been packaged, priced, or sold for leisure or recreational purposes by an organization that realizes financial gain through the provision of the service. Passenger ages or entrance passes do not affect the price.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Group, 7-15 Passenger Capacity
entranceFees.description: This entrance fee is for commercial tours of vehicles with a seating capacity of 7-15 people that has been packaged, priced, or sold for leisure or recreational purposes by an organization that realizes financial gain through the provision of the service. This fee is based on the seating capacity of the vehicle and not the actual number of passengers. Passenger ages or entrance passes do not affect the price.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Group, 16-25 Passenger Capacity
entranceFees.description: This entrance fee is for commercial tours of vehicles with a seating capacity of 16-25 people that has been packaged, priced, or sold for leisure or recreational purposes by an organization that realizes financial gain through the provision of the service. This fee is based on the seating capacity of the vehicle and not the actual number of passengers. Passenger ages or entrance passes do not affect the price.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Group, 26+ Passenger Capacity
entranceFees.description: This entrance fee is for commercial tours of vehicles with a seating capacity of 26 or more people that has been packaged, priced, or sold for leisure or recreational purposes by an organization that realizes financial gain through the provision of the service. This fee is based on the seating capacity of the vehicle and not the actual number of passengers. Passenger ages or entrance passes do not affect the price.

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle Pass
entranceFees.description: This pass is valid for 1-7 days and includes everyone traveling on a motorcycle, scooter, or similar motorized vehicle for Sequoia & Kings Canyon National Parks and Hume Lake District of Sequoia National Forest/Giant Sequoia National Monument.

entrancePasses.title: Sequoia & Kings Canyon Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: This pass is valid for Sequoia & Kings Canyon National Parks and Hume Lake Ranger District of Sequoia National Forest/Giant Sequoia National Monument for one year from the month of purchase. The pass admits all passengers in a private vehicle and is non-transferable.

entranceFees.title: Shenandoah Entrance Fee - Single Vehicle
entranceFees.description: This fee covers unlimited entry for one vehicle and all passengers for seven consecutive days, beginning on the day of purchase. Vehicles must be private, noncommercial, and with a seating capacity of 15 or less.

entranceFees.title: Shenandoah Entrance Fee - Single Motorcycle
entranceFees.description: Covers entry for one motorcycle and one passenger for seven consecutive days, beginning on the day of purchase.

entranceFees.title: Shenandoah Entrance Fee - Individual Person
entranceFees.description: The fee for walk-up or bicycling visitors, when 16 years of age or older (children under 16 are admitted for free). Includes entering the Park by all means other than a private, non-commercial vehicle. A family traveling together shall pay no more than the vehicle fee.

entranceFees.title: Shenandoah Entrance Fee - Commercial Tour (1-6 Passengers)
entranceFees.description: The total cost is calculated: $25 + $10 per passenger

entranceFees.title: Shenandoah Entrance Fee - Commercial Tour (7-15 Passengers)
entranceFees.description: This entry fee is based upon the total capacity of a vehicle that can carry 7-15 passengers, regardless of the actual number of passengers.

entranceFees.title: Shenandoah Entrance Fee - Commercial Tour (16-25 Passengers)
entranceFees.description: This entry fee is based upon the total capacity of a vehicle that can carry 16-25 passengers, regardless of the actual number of passengers

entranceFees.title: Shenandoah Entrance Fee - Commercial Tour (26+ Passengers)
entranceFees.description: This entry fee is based upon the total capacity of a vehicle that can carry 26 or more passengers, regardless of the actual number of passengers

entrancePasses.title: Shenandoah Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Provides unlimited entry for one year to the pass holder and passengers in the same vehicle, not to exceed 4 total adults. Children under 16 are admitted for free and are not included in this total.

entranceFees.title: Vehicle Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: Entrance to all units of Theodore Roosevelt National Park for one private, non-commercial vehicle and its occupants for 7 days.

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: Entrance to all units of Theodore Roosevelt National Park for one motorcycle and its riders for 7 days.

entranceFees.title: Non-motorized Individual Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: Per-person fee grants access for individuals on foot, bicycle, or horseback to all units of Theodore Roosevelt National Park for 7 days.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Vehicle 1-6 Passenger Capacity
entranceFees.description:
Entrance to all units of Theodore Roosevelt National Park for one 1-6 passenger capacity commercial vehicle and its occupants for 7 days. 

**Additional fee of $15 per person in addition to the $25 Commercial Vehicle fee.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Vehicle 7-15 Passenger Capacity
entranceFees.description: Entrance to all units of Theodore Roosevelt National Park for one 7-15 passenger capacity commercial vehicle and its occupants for 7 days.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Vehicle 16-25 Passenger Capacity
entranceFees.description: Entrance to all units of Theodore Roosevelt National Park for a 16-25 passenger capacity commercial vehicle and its occupants for 7 days.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Vehicle 25+ Passenger Capacity
entranceFees.description: Entrance to all units of Theodore Roosevelt National Park for one 25+ passenger capacity commercial vehicle and its occupants for 7 days.

entrancePasses.title: Theodore Roosevelt National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Entrance to all units of Theodore Roosevelt National Park for one year from month of purchase. Admits pass holder and passengers in a single, private, non-commercial vehicle, or the pass holder and his/her immediate family (spouse, children, parents) when entry is by other means (foot, bicycle, etc.).

entranceFees.description: There is no entrance fee for Virgin Islands National Park

entranceFees.title: Voyageurs Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: No entrance fees associated with this park.  Camping amenity fees are separate fees.

entranceFees.title: White Sands National Park Entrance - Vehicle
entranceFees.description: Per vehicle fee is charged to visitors for entry by a single, private non-commercial vehicle. Entrance fees are valid for reentry for seven consecutive days from the date of purchase.

entranceFees.title: White Sands National Park Entrance - Person
entranceFees.description: Per person fee is charged to visitors for entry by means other than a single, private non-commercial vehicle. This includes, but is not limited to, individuals who enter the park by walking and bicycling. Entrance fees are valid for reentry for seven consecutive days from the date of purchase.

entranceFees.title: White Sands National Park Entrance - Motorcycle
entranceFees.description: Entrance fees are valid for entry for seven consecutive days from the date of purchase.

entranceFees.title: White Sands National Park Entrance - Annual Vehicle Pass
entranceFees.description: This pass admits the pass holder and three persons (16 years and older) in a private non-commercial vehicle into the park for free for a period of one year from month of purchase. It can only be purchased at the entrance station to White Sands National Park. This pass does not apply to special use fees, such as camping and interpretive program fees.

entranceFees.title: America the Beautiful - Annual Park Pass
entranceFees.description: The America the Beautiful National Parks and Federal Recreational Lands Pass is your ticket to more than 2,000 federal recreation sites across the country. A pass covers entrance, standard amenity fees and day use fees for a driver and all passengers in a personal vehicle at per vehicle fee areas (or up to four adults at sites that charge per person). Children age 15 or under are admitted free.

entrancePasses.title: White Sands Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: This pass is valid for the card holder and three other adults within the same vehicle. Pass is good for one year from month of purchase.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: There are no fees to drive through or hike in the park. Enjoy!

entranceFees.title: No Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: There is no entrance fee at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts.

entranceFees.title: Entrance Fee
entranceFees.description: Fee free park

entranceFees.title: Yellowstone (non-commercial vehicle)
entranceFees.description: Good for entry into Yellowstone National Park for seven days from the date of purchase.

entranceFees.title: Yellowstone (motorcycle or snowmobile)
entranceFees.description: Good for entry into Yellowstone National Park for seven days from the date of purchase. Snowmobile entry limited to guided tours or permit holders.

entranceFees.title: Yellowstone (individual on foot, bicycle, etc.)
entranceFees.description: Good for entry into Yellowstone National Park for seven days from the date of purchase.

entrancePasses.title: Yellowstone National Park Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Annual pass providing free entrance into Yellowstone National Park for one year (valid through the month of purchase). On a snowmobile, this pass admits the signer(s). When traveling by snowcoach or shuttle, this pass admits a signer and up to three additional persons (16 and older) for a total of four people.

entranceFees.title: Non-commercial car, pickup truck, RV, or van with 15 or fewer passenger seats
entranceFees.description: This fee is valid for seven days.

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle
entranceFees.description: This fee is valid for seven days. Cost is per motorcycle (not per person).

entranceFees.title: Foot, bicycle, horse, or non-commercial bus or van with more than 15 passenger seats
entranceFees.description: This fee is valid for seven days. People 15 years and younger are free. Cost is per person.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Tour (sedan up to six seats)
entranceFees.description: The fee is $25 plus $20 per person, not to exceed $105.

entranceFees.title: Commercial Tour (van, 7-15 seats, regardless of occupancy)
Commercial Tour (mini bus, 16-25 seats, regardless of occupancy)
Commercial Tour (motor coach, 26 or more seats, regardless of occupancy)

entrancePasses.title: Yosemite Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Annual pass providing free entrance to Yosemite for 12 months from the date of purchase.

entrancePasses.title: America the Beautiful—National Parks and Federal Recreational Lands Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Annual pass covering entrance and standard amenity fees for national parks and other federal fee areas, valid for 12 months from date of purchase. This replaces the National Parks Pass and Golden Eagle Pass.

entrancePasses.title: Senior Pass
entrancePasses.description: Lifetime or annual admission and discount pass for US citizens or permanent residents who are age 62 or older. An annual version of this pass, valid for 12 months, costs $20.

entrancePasses.title: Access Pass
entrancePasses.description: Lifetime admission and discount pass for US citizens or permanent residents with permanent disabilities.

entrancePasses.title: Annual Pass for US Military
entrancePasses.description: Annual pass covering entrance and standard amenity fees for all active US military personnel and their dependents, valid for 12 months from date of issuance. (For active duty military personnel and dependents with proper identification (CAC Card or DD Form 1173).)

entrancePasses.title: Annual 4th Grade Pass
entrancePasses.description: Annual pass covering entrance fees for 4th grade students for 2018–2019 school year.

entranceFees.title: Private Vehicle: Valid for 7 days.
entranceFees.description: Admits private, non-commercial vehicle (15 passenger capacity or less) and all occupants to Zion National Park, including both the Zion Canyon and Kolob Canyon areas.

entranceFees.title: Motorcycle: Valid for 7 days.
entranceFees.description: Admits one non-commercial motorcycle to Zion National Park, including both the Zion Canyon and Kolob Canyon areas.

entranceFees.title: Per Person: Valid for 7 days.
entranceFees.description: Admits one individual with no car to Zion National Park, including both the Zion Canyon and Kolob Canyon areas. Typically used for bicyclists, hikers and pedestrians. Youth 15 and under are admitted free.

entranceFees.title: Non-Commercial Organized Groups: Valid for 7 days.
entranceFees.description:
Organized groups such as Scouts, Clubs, Youth Groups, Churches, Reunions, etc. that do not qualify for an Academic Fee Waiver are charged as follows: 
$35.00 Non-commercial vehicles with a vehicle capacity of 15 or less.
$20.00 per person Non-commercial vehicles with a capacity of 16 or greater. Fees will not exceed the commercial fee for the same-sized vehicle. Youth 15 and under are free. Individuals or families with any valid Annual or Lifetime pass may use their pass for entry at the per person rate.

entrancePasses.title: Interagency Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Admission to all Federal fee areas for one year from date of purchase.

entrancePasses.title: Zion Annual Pass
entrancePasses.description: Admission to Zion National Park for one year from date of purchase.

entrancePasses.title: Annual Senior Pass
entrancePasses.description: Admission to all federal fee areas for one year from date of purchase.

entrancePasses.title: Lifetime Senior Pass
entrancePasses.description: Admission to all federal fee areas for life, U.S. citizens 62 years or older.

entrancePasses.title: Lifetime Access Pass
entrancePasses.description: Admission to all federal fee areas for life, permanently disabled U.S. citizens

entrancePasses.title: Free Access for Veterans and Gold Star Families
entrancePasses.description:
Since Veterans Day 2020, Gold Star Families and US military veterans are eligible to receive free access to more than 2,000 federal recreation areas, including national parks, wildlife refuges, and forests. The free access program is a way to thank America’s veterans, Gold Star Families, and current military and their dependents for their support of our country.

Learn more: https://www.nps.gov/planyourvisit/veterans-and-gold-star-families-free-access.htm

entrancePasses.title: Volunteer Pass
entrancePasses.description: Admission to all federal fee areas for one year from issue date. Volunteers with over 250 hours of service are eligible.
